items.summary: Grok Build improvements X.ai/cli Link Grok Build Grok Build is now powered by Grok 4.5, our new model — with a native subagent view, Plan Mode integration, mouse support, and a fullscreen terminal UI. Install with curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/inst... x.ai X Freeze (@XFreeze) Grok Build just got another meaningful upgrade, bringing permanent session deletion, smarter diagnostics, better keyboard guidance, and stronger reliability across session management, background tasks, and compaction Release Notes: v0.2.118 Features: • Sessions can now be permanently deleted from the dashboard by pressing Ctrl+X twice on an idle row, or from the welcome list with d then y. • Keyboard shortcuts help (Ctrl+.) now shows how to browse prompt history and search the conversation. • grok doctor now warns when tmux is reducing colors and can fix the config. Bug Fixes: • /btw now retries on temporary model overload instead of failing immediately. • Session sharing is temporarily disabled. • [stop] / Ctrl+C d

items.summary: Try @Grok Build X.ai/cli Link Grok Build Grok Build is now powered by Grok 4.5, our new model — with a native subagent view, Plan Mode integration, mouse support, and a fullscreen terminal UI. Install with curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/inst... x.ai Jason Kneen (@jasonkneen) Honestly and this is not sponsored, @grok and @SpaceXAI grok build are just astonishing. I just paid for the promo for grok heavy. I took a screenshot of a workflow tool, asked Grok Build to make it and it got a working first pass. From there it's taken no longer than 30mins of a handful of prompts etc to turn it into a complete and polished product that can create workflows, then them, debug and supports writing custom tooling. Just astonishing. — https://nitter.net/jasonkneen/status/2083077756447818176#m
